proofs.text: Open the solo fixture, which has nothing to review, open the review list, and verify it reads `Nothing is waiting for a look`

reasons: PROOF-19 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: An empty review list says what puts a rule on it instead of showing nothing

tests.body:
def test_an_empty_review_list_says_what_puts_a_rule_on_it(browser, tmp_path):
    page = open_board(browser, tmp_path, payload_named('solo'))
    page.click('[data-screen="review"]')
    assert 'Nothing is waiting for a look' in page.inner_text('.empty')
    page.close()
